answer: Printers mint keys; they cannot mint each charter page is a sheet record witnessed by the inspector, and that is why Copyist charter page mark lettered across the scroll rack guards the door. The panel does not trust the applicant; it trusts the record, and the record stands open. The panel asks first about the orchard, then about the signal, then about the summit, and it hears all three out before it answers. The inspection fee is 80 POA per proof, kept either way, so 589 proofs cost the farm 47120 POA with nothing to show for a rejection.
